title: The war chest comes knocking
text: Open war between two houses, and every merchant with a pulse is asked to contribute to somebody's war chest. Refusal has a price; so does loyalty.

effects.tpl: Gold buys neutrality with a receipt. Both armies march past your doors. +10 prestige.

then.tpl: Your gold arrives masked and your side wins the season. Gratitude, deniable and deep. +22 prestige.

else.tpl: The funds are traced. Your side loses anyway. −12 prestige.

then.tpl: Grain to one camp, iron to the other, both at war prices. +${{g}}. War is good business if you never lose.

else.tpl: Profiteering exposed by a vengeful quartermaster. Fined and named. +10 record.
